description: Compute the SHA-256 fingerprint of a local file (streamed, never sent anywhere) and attest it: the server timestamps it and returns a signed attestation. Requires a credential — run 'authorize' first, or set IMGAUTH_API_KEY. Optional declared metadata (titolo/autore/anno/note) is bound to the signature.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the local file.

name: attest_file
title: Attest a file
